title: Coal Stock at Power Stations (Daily, CEA)
description: Daily coal stock at coal-based thermal power stations monitored by CEA's Fuel Management Division, in thousand tonnes: total, indigenous and imported, with the day's receipts and consumption, the number of plants with critical stock (below 25% of the normative requirement) and total stock as a percentage of the normative requirement. Falling stock with rising consumption is an early warning of supply constraints (and of strong power demand); rising stock signals either weak off-take or strong coal supply.
source: Central Electricity Authority (Fuel Management Division), Daily Coal Report

qna.question: What does this measure?
qna.answer: The coal in stock at the yard of each coal-based power station that reports to CEA, summed to an all-India Grand Total (the 'Grand Total = A+B+C+D' line of CEA's daily coal report), in thousand tonnes. It is a stock (a level on the day), split into indigenous and imported coal, with the day's receipts and consumption.^The report covers about 200 GW of coal-based capacity; imported-coal plants and captive/IPP plants are included.

qna.question: How should I read it?
qna.answer: Compare the stock with the normative level (the stock each plant should hold, in days of requirement at 85% load factor). A reading below 100% of normative is not unusual; the number of plants below 25% of normative (critical) is the stress signal. Stocks normally build in the monsoon and fall in the summer demand peak.^Consumption of the day is a direct measure of coal burnt for power and moves with demand.

qna.question: Definitions, revisions and caveats
qna.answer: Figures are as reported by stations the next day and are provisional; CEA does not publish revisions to old daily files. The report layout has changed over time (a daily-requirement column was added or dropped); the parser reads the Grand Total row and checks that indigenous plus imported stock equals total stock.^Daily files are available from mid-2024 only, so this series starts then. Days with no file are left blank.
